applicabilityBasis.summary: Solstice markets USX as an overcollateralized dollar settlement asset, permits permissionless minting with USDC and USDT, and describes it as a payment rail. The public materials do not resolve the legal issuer, U.S. qualification pathway, or whether an applicable foreign-issuer exception exists, so the token is treated as an apparent payment stablecoin without assuming authorization.

genius.notes: No public GENIUS approval, state-qualified status, official application, or OCC foreign registration naming Solstice Foundation or USX was located in the reviewed materials. The classification is not an authorization finding. Solstice's homepage claims a MiCA-ready framework, while its linked EU/EEA MiCA disclosure currently resolves to a page-not-found; a verifier should re-check the EU offering and any later regulator filing.
